name: peekhassio
description: Peek at Home Assistant entity states from the GNOME top bar.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:node && npm run test:gjs
scripts.test:node: node --test tests/credential-store.test.mjs tests/home-assistant-client.test.mjs tests/metadata.test.mjs tests/package.test.mjs tests/panel-view.test.mjs tests/runtime-coordinator.test.mjs
scripts.coverage: npm run build && npm run coverage:node && npm run coverage:gjs
scripts.coverage:node: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=81 --test-coverage-branches=81 --test-coverage-functions=81 tests/credential-store.test.mjs tests/home-assistant-client.test.mjs tests/metadata.test.mjs tests/package.test.mjs tests/panel-view.test.mjs tests/runtime-coordinator.test.mjs
scripts.coverage:gjs: gjs -C file://$PWD/dist/action-runner.js -C file://$PWD/dist/configuration.js -C file://$PWD/dist/credential-store.js -C file://$PWD/dist/preferences-view.js --coverage-output=coverage/gjs -m tests/configuration.test.mjs && node scripts/check-gjs-coverage.mjs
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && node scripts/copy-metadata.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && gnome-extensions pack --force --out-dir . --extra-source=action-runner.js --extra-source=configuration.js --extra-source=credential-store.js --extra-source=entity-state-client.js --extra-source=home-assistant-client.js --extra-source=panel-renderer.js --extra-source=panel-view.js --extra-source=preferences-view.js --extra-source=runtime-coordinator.js --extra-source=secret-service.js --extra-source=soup-websocket-transport.js --schema=schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.peekhassio.gschema.xml dist
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run coverage
